# Badir — A Builder Community for Muslims. We don't build for the ummah; we build with it.

> Note: Badir (badir.studio) is a builder community and product studio founded in 2026 in Tauranga, New Zealand. It is NOT affiliated with the BADIR Program technology incubator in Saudi Arabia.

## About
Badir (بادر) is a builder community for Muslims who want to build real things — products, brands, tools — and serve the ummah while doing it. Problem-first and session-based: bring a real problem or join one, jam it out together in a working session, ship it as a team, and every builder gets credited. A product studio side (brand strategy, MVP development, AI automation) sustains the work — the work funds itself so it can keep serving.

## How it works (Build With Us)
1. LISTEN — bring the problem (yours, or pick one that's open)
2. CREATE — jam it together in a ~45-minute session (Lightning Decision Jam format)
3. SHIP — build it as a team; each person owns a piece; everyone is credited

Current open builds:
- The New Muslim Starter Pack — one clear path for a new Muslim's first 90 days (reverts are overwhelmed by scattered info; this replaces confusion with one next step)
- Da'wah in the Digital Age — how Muslims actually show up online, with honesty and beauty
- The Ummah Uplift Team — designers, developers, writers, video people and marketers who go to mosques and communities and uplift their projects with skills

Join at: https://badir.studio/build

## Founder
Mustafa Kivanc Demirsoy (MKD) — Builder. No corporate titles by choice: "I'm here to do the work, not to be called something."
Has shipped multiple live products (WeHack, LUA Jewellery, MarketMate, TSK, TrustLock, SortedAI) — every one started by saying Bismillah and shipping an ugly first version. Leans on AI for the boring parts to spend more time building with people.
Location: Tauranga, New Zealand (global reach)

## Brand Voice
- Direct, energetic, zero lectures
- Tone: Like the Muslim friend who already shipped and is pulling you along
- Says "ship" not "launch", "builders" not "members"
- Uses "Bismillah" naturally (not performatively)
- Always action-oriented, never preachy
- No titles, no credentialism — judge the work, not the label

## Studio Services (sustains the community — 4-Phase Pipeline)
1. Discovery — Market research, competitor audit, audience intelligence, ICP profiling
2. Brand — CORE framework brand discovery, positioning, voice, design system, messaging
3. Build — Websites, MVPs, marketing materials, content, creatives, AI automation
4. Monitor — Performance tracking, SEO/GEO monitoring, brand mentions, optimization

## Pricing (studio)
- Product Sprint (48hr): $2K-5K per sprint
- MVP Development: $5K-20K project-based
- Brand Strategy (full pipeline): $3K-10K
- AI Automation Setup: $5K-15K
- Monthly Monitoring: $500-2K/mo retainer

## Community Profiles
- Yusuf (19-24): Stuck student with ideas he never ships. Needs accountability and a room that tells him to start
- Amira (24-32): Side hustle builder. Needs structured rhythm, not "learn at your own pace"
- Omar (28-40): Experienced builder. Wants to mentor where mentees actually ship

## Tagline
"Bismillah, ship it." — Take the initiative, be first to act, hasten to do good.

## Name Origin
Badir (بادر) means "Take the initiative" / "Be the first to act" / "Hasten to do good."
Inspired by the Battle of Badr — 313 against an army three times their size; victory through faith + action, not numbers.
Quranic reference: Surah Al-Baqarah (2:148) — "So race to [all that is] good."
